**Fit with the design**

Rollcall has ten non-negotiables (docs/00-README.md) and a deliberately small
POC scope (docs/01-DESIGN.md §4, ROADMAP.md "Deliberately NOT in the POC").
If your proposal touches vouching, messaging, company claims, scores, or
anything that surfaces negative signals or personal emails, please read those
first and say how the proposal fits — several "obvious" features are
deliberate non-choices with recorded reasoning.
